original_ai_output.title_zh: ADC党成员在阿布贾抗议法院判决书迟迟未发布
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 非洲民主大会党（ADC）成员在阿布贾联邦高等法院外举行抗议，要求立即发放宣布该党全国工作委员会（由前参议院议长戴维·马克领导）无效的判决书认证副本。抗议者指控主审法官Peter Lifu扣留11月5日作出的判决，妨碍其向上诉法院提出上诉。抗议者还呼吁国家司法委员会介入。该事件目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: ADC党成员在阿布贾联邦高等法院举行抗议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Members of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) have staged a protest at the Federal High Court in Abuja

key_facts.fact: 抗议者要求立即发放判决书认证副本
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: demanding the immediate release of the Certified True Copy of the judgment nullifying the party's National Working Committee led by former Senate President, David Mark

key_facts.fact: 抗议者指控主审法官Peter Lifu扣留11月5日作出的判决
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: accused the trial judge, Justice Peter Lifu, of withholding the judgment delivered on November 5

key_facts.fact: 抗议者呼吁国家司法委员会介入
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: called on the National Judicial Council to intervene

uncertainties: 法官扣留判决书的指控尚未获独立证实
目前仅有一个来源（Sahara Reporters）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
